description: DAD (Duplicate Address Detection) hash algorithm clarification vectors. Spec section 4.5 contains two conflicting pseudocode blocks: one uses crc32_ieee(key=0x4c494348454e), the other uses fnv1a32(basis=0x811c9dc5). This file documents the authoritative resolution and provides test vectors for both algorithms to ensure implementations use the correct one.
oracle_provenance: Independent implementation of both hash algorithms. CRC32-IEEE uses polynomial 0x04C11DB7 with initial value truncated from 0x4c494348454e to 0x4348454e (32-bit). FNV-1a32 uses basis 0x811c9dc5 and prime 0x01000193.

resolution.note: The fnv1a32 pseudocode in section 4.5 appears to be a copy-paste error from the channel selection algorithm in section 02a. Short address derivation uses CRC32-IEEE per the existing short_addr_dad.json vectors which are the authoritative source.
